If I wish to say absolutely what I want here to what degree does a VPN shield me?

It depends on the VPN, it depends on everything else you do, and it depends on who's trying to find you.

Hiding secrets from your neighbor is easy. Hiding secrets from the police is hard. Hiding them from the NSA is very hard.

If your computer is itself insecure, than any software you run on it - including the world's best VPN - is insecure, too. And if it's a PC connected to the internet, it's insecure.

Most of your protection comes from training yourself to never, ever, do things you normally do.

If you ever log into something with an account, make sure you never do it with your VPN on. Otherwise you just gave up all your anonymity. Vice versa, never use the same browsing habits with a VPN on that you do with the VPN off. Don't use the same browser for safe browsing and normal browsing. Those cookies and flash blobs follow you around the internet.
